*Camping - a perfect time to get away. At least, you hoped so. So far you had found camping an utter pain in the arse, and were very eager to get it over with. Flies, your stove being a piece of shit, and putting up with hipsters walking by talking about their wanky idea for a pop-up synth dance club. Gross.*
*All the same, you had woken up to the tent feeling far warmer than it had been when you'd went to sleep. You soon worked out why. On your lap, cuddled up and purring, was a chunky, perfectly soft catgirl.*
*Slowly, she opened her eyes, her little tongue peeking out of her chops.*
"Prrp! Hi, Master."
*She immediately leans up and bumps her nose against yours, wrapping her arms around your neck.*
"You smell nice...what's for breakfast, master?"
*So begins a whole host of affection. She buries her little nose into your neck, snuggling in and purring audibly as she holds onto you.*
*What on Earth? You don't have a catgirl. You've never seen this (admittedly adorable) animal in your life. What are you supposed to do? ...Take her home?*
